source: Haynes maintenance plans (UK), Škoda Octavia IV (VW group regime) — manufacturer service intervals
disclaimer: Intervals are 'whichever comes first'. 1.0 / 1.5 TSI engines have a timing belt with no fixed replacement interval: it is inspected at services. DSG gearbox oil, where needed, depends on the gearbox type: check your service booklet.

tasks.title: Regular service: engine oil & filter
tasks.notes: Fixed service: every 15,000 km or every year. With LongLife (flexible) service the car tells you when it is due, up to 30,000 km or 2 years. Use oil with the VW approval in your handbook.

tasks.title: Steering, suspension, ball joints & driveshaft gaiters
Air filter (induction)
tasks.notes: More often in dusty or polluted conditions.

tasks.title: Safety kit (warning triangle, vest, first aid kit)
tasks.notes: Check the first aid kit expiry date. A vest and warning triangle are mandatory in France and Italy.

tasks.title: Monthly owner checks
tasks.notes: Engine oil level · coolant level · brake fluid level · pipes, hoses & reservoirs for leaks · A/C operation · parking brake · horn · wheel nut tightness.

tasks.title: Tyre pressures & condition (when refuelling)
tasks.notes: Also check washer fluid. Pressures are on the label in the driver's door frame.

tasks.title: Roadworthiness test (contrôle technique / MOT / revisione)
tasks.notes: Depends on your country. France & Italy: first at 4 years, then every 2 years. UK MOT: first at 3 years, then yearly. Edit this item to match your country.
